The Functionize Agentic Platform
Built to end brittle testing once and for all

The world doesn’t need another automation tool. It needs a revolution.


Functionize is the first AI-native testing platform powered by specialized agents that think, adapt, and act. These aren’t scripts or plug‑ins, they are intelligent systems built to eliminate the grind of test creation and maintenance, so engineering teams can finally move at the speed of innovation.

Cloud First. AI First. Agentic at the Core.
Functionize delivers quality at scale for enterprises ready to move from reactive QA to truly intelligent, adaptive testing.
ENTERPRISE APP INTELLIGENCE
Unmatched Application Intelligence

Eight years of enterprise training and 30,000+ data points per page power Functionize’s AI to achieve 99.97% element recognition accuracy, cutting flaky tests and maintenance by 80%.

Agentic Platform at the Core

Our agentic AI builds, runs, diagnoses, and self heals tests end to end with minimal human input. Each agent delivers measurable value by reducing maintenance, accelerating execution, and scaling intelligently across your entire testing lifecycle.

Tests in Seconds

Go from idea to execution in record time. Non technical teams can create and deploy tests in seconds, up to 90% faster than traditional scripting approaches.

Unbounded Parallel Testing

Stateless, containerized agents spin up thousands of tests instantly across browsers, devices, and geographies, empowering teams to release faster with zero trade offs.

"Our partnership with Functionize has marked a pivotal shift in our QA processes. We’re navigating the complexities of global digital landscapes with unprecedented efficiency and precision. Our testing is dramatically accelerated, times reduced from hours to minutes, and our coverage expanded across global markets with agility. This leap in efficiency is not just a win for McAfee but a forward step in ensuring a secure digital world more swiftly and effectively."

Venkatesh Hebbar, Senior QA Manager

GE Healthcare reduced 40 hours of testing time to just 4 hours, achieving 90% labor savings.

"Working with Functionize has really transformed our QA practice at Kognitiv. We went from cringing when UI or code changes were done because of cumbersome and time-consuming processes to welcoming them due to the flexibility and mature self-healing logic that is built into the platform."


Duncan Anderson, VP of Quality Assurance

CASE STUDY
90%+ Test Coverage & Visual Accuracy: Enabled global QA team to expand automated test coverage to 90% during a migration while using pixel-perfect visual regression testing.
Regression Cycles Cut 40–70%:
Suites that ran 6 hours now complete in under 2. Cloud Scale execution accelerates launches and shortens time-to-market.
Global Payment Testing at Scale: Automated testing across 40 countries and 30+ payment methods using Functionize’s TDM validating up to 180 localized pages daily.
Transformed manual testers into automation specialists through Functionize’s intuitive, AI-powered platform, boosting productivity and consistency across digital experiences.

Machine learning in software testing

Software testing has always been an essential part of the software development lifecycle. Originally, it was a manual process that took significant time and effort. Then came test automation, allowing testing to become more efficient and fast. Now, artificial intelligence (AI) is transforming software testing in ways that could not have been dreamt of a decade ago. This includes simplifying test creation, reducing the need for test maintenance, and driving new ways to assess the results.


Learn More
What is Regression Testing?

One of the most important testing techniques in terms of overall impact on quality is regression testing. Testing engineers typically devote a lot of time and effort towards regression testing, and for good reason.

Learn More
Selenium testing

Selenium is an open source web browser automation framework. It’s a combination of several different tools - the Selenium IDE, Selenium WebDriver, Selenium RC, and Selenium Grid. Together these tools offer users a single interface for inputting test scripts in a number of popular coding languages.

Learn More
Automated testing

Automated testing has transformed modern software development. Before test automation, all tests had to be done manually. This was slow, error-prone, and expensive. As a result, it often led to QA teams being seen as a blocker to releasing software.

Learn More
